claim_as_stated: Under CH there is a countable finitary relational AEC K with LS(K)=aleph_0, two nonisomorphic models at beth_(omega_2)=h(aleph_0), and categoricity in every mu>=Lambda=beth_((2^(aleph_1))^+). Hence the specified prescribed-threshold transfer formulations are not provable in consistent ZFC; this remains compatible with qualitative eventual categoricity.
proof_architecture: Under CH code countable extensional ordinal-tagged diagrams into S=2^omega/=*, demanding exact restrictions for all subsequences.

Build row finite-B-support torsors and column finite-omega-support torsors. Allow tuple-dependent countable exceptions in objects, but no exceptions at new coordinates in strong extensions; verify all AEC axioms and LS=aleph_0.

Use an omega_2-long sequence of functions omega_1->omega_1 increasing modulo countable sets to approximate true ranks on countable closures in V_(omega_2), producing an endpoint model with uncountable base; compare with a countable-base model.

A fixed valid color at every finite arity yields a coherent direct-limit extensional relation over an arbitrarily large set. Tags below omega_1 collapse it injectively into V_(omega_1), a contradiction.

Finite partition estimates below strong-limit Lambda and unbounded sample selection produce those fixed colors if the index sort is too large. Countably many witness exceptions leave one coordinate in uncountable B; hence such bases have index size <Lambda.
For countable B, allocate matrix differences k<=n to row n and n<k to column k. Finite translators then give an isomorphism, proving categoricity at every mu>=Lambda.

construction_ideas.exact_assumptions: An arbitrary countable-by-countable F_2 difference matrix with independent finite-support row and column translations and no relations linking tuple fibers.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Give entry (n,k) to row n for k<=n, otherwise to column k. Every entry is corrected once, every row gets at most n+1 positions, and every column at most k positions.
construction_ideas.possible_speculative_bridge: Order row/column choices in a determinant construction to allocate dangerous weighted entries or occupancy obligations while leaving each local correction finite and preserving a chosen leading term.
construction_ideas.limits: Supplies neither height control nor nonzero determinant nor sign control; F_2 translations are much freer than allowed arithmetic row operations.

construction_ideas.idea: Finite compatible certificates without a common infinite homogeneous set
construction_ideas.exact_assumptions: Palettes <=xi, Lambda strong limit of cofinality >xi, countable tuple exception sets, and an uncountable coordinate base.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Fix one color per arity from arbitrarily large homogeneous samples; use a different finite witness at each arity, remove only countably many witness exceptions, and evaluate all certificates at one good coordinate.
construction_ideas.possible_speculative_bridge: For minors over Q(Z), distinguish coherent finite rank certificates from an unjustified demand for one nested infinite family. Restriction-compatible leading terms could allow finite certificates dimension by dimension.
construction_ideas.limits: Requires a new finite quantitative analogue and compatibility/nonvanishing proof; this cardinal argument has no supplied arithmetic bound.

construction_ideas.exact_assumptions: Finite translators, old supports remain unchanged, and finitely many subsequences per tuple.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Global representative changes affect only countably many coordinates, but old changes affect no new coordinate exactly. Select all representatives for one finite tuple in one stage before taking unions.
construction_ideas.possible_speculative_bridge: Design symbolic row operations supported only on earlier columns, freeze old data, then extend the determinant family without damaging later columns.
construction_ideas.limits: Approximation errors usually lack exact finite support, so a quantitative replacement is necessary.

title: A Modulus Proof of Cannon's Conjecture
sections_read: Introduction, completion, and consequences
Geometry: expansions and punctures, prefixes, packing, paths, uniformization criterion, action straightening

scope_note: README identifies paper.pdf. Tree/root traversal identifies build/main.tex. Every root line, five included body sections, two included TeX figures, and included bibliography were read. No unresolved body input or appendix remains.
claim_as_stated: Every word-hyperbolic group with boundary homeomorphic to S^2 admits a proper cocompact isometric action on H^3 with finite kernel, including orientation-reversing elements. For torsion-free groups the quotient is a closed hyperbolic three-manifold, with stated virtual fibering/specialness/residual-finiteness consequences.
proof_architecture: Reduce via a cited approximately self-similar sphere criterion to bounded macroscopic combinatorial 2-moduli M(n); boundary uniformization and invariant conformal structures then straighten the action.
If M is unbounded, take record scales M(N-l)<=lambda^(-l)M(N). Localize crossing modulus to a rectangle and use least-norm incidence-vector duality for dual weights of energy O(1/M(N)).

Use two path envelopes to obtain separating level continua. Annular estimates yield a nonconstant scalar limit u and finite measure mu controlling squared oscillation; mesh energies vanish after each fixed transform.

For exponential records, normalized Holder magnification gives a punctured-sphere limit. Finite-cell level comparisons constrain transforms with distinct punctures; a second magnification with two disjoint variation ranges contradicts the constraint.

For subexponential records, construct a separated tree with nested intervals and both linear and quadratic probability bounds. A capacity estimate and finite squared interval energy force good mass at arbitrarily deep levels, with finitely many target patterns.

At one depth choose a pattern/probability class. Most puncture pairs are far; each pair must pay positive mu-mass in a cost ball. Quadratically many costs exceed the packing/multiplicity upper bound, closing boundedness of M.

construction_ideas.idea: Simultaneous linear/quadratic flow budgets and pair-cost contradiction
construction_ideas.exact_assumptions: Packing exponent Q, expansions with two-sided puncture formula, finite measure controlling squared oscillation, nested intervals, separated children, and subexponential modulus growth. Transition bounds p<=a^(-gamma D)t and p<=a^(-D/2)t^2 at bad nodes, p<=a^(tau D)t^2 generally.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Linear telescoping spreads branch probability; quadratic bounds plus bounded squared interval sum force good nodes. Finite pattern and dyadic classes give many far pairs, while each cost ball is charged only with bounded multiplicity.
construction_ideas.possible_speculative_bridge: Put a probability flow on choices of weighted columns or surviving monomials. A linear occupancy bound could spread certificates and quadratic energy force structurally good branches; pair counting could make unavoidable costs exceed a global occupancy bound.
construction_ideas.limits: All source costs are nonnegative. Signed determinant terms need a separate noncancellation lemma, and rank over Q(Z) alone supplies no pair-cost alternative.

construction_ideas.idea: Convex duality separating coverage from small energy
construction_ideas.exact_assumptions: Finitely many nonnegative crossing incidence vectors and transverse vectors having inner product >=1 with each crossing vector.
construction_ideas.mechanism: For the least-norm P in their convex hull, <P,v>>=||P||^2 and primal modulus=||P||^-2; P itself is transverse admissible with reciprocal energy.
construction_ideas.possible_speculative_bridge: Encode allowed surviving determinant terms as weighted column-incidence vectors and seek a convex certificate minimizing squared column cost while enforcing coverage.
construction_ideas.limits: Must prove the arithmetic incidence-intersection property and separate algebraic cancellation from positive convex feasibility.

construction_ideas.idea: Freeze structural choices before analytic approximation
construction_ideas.exact_assumptions: Constants are finite for each fixed group transform/pair and compact region; no uniform rate across all choices is claimed.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Fix h_j and its normalization first, then choose approximation N_j. Fix the pair and its positive interval before taking N to infinity.
construction_ideas.possible_speculative_bridge: Freeze a symbolic minor, denominator clearing, and nonzero coefficient before choosing approximation scale at pi; record all dependence before asserting determinant <1.
construction_ideas.limits: Diagonalization only chooses scales; it does not prove coexistence with the required height and smallness inequalities.

claim_as_stated: For smooth connected oriented one-ended complete 3-dimensional exterior data with nonempty compact boundary, g-delta=O_2(r^-q), K=O_1(r^(-1-q)) for q>1/2, source-free E/B=O_1(r^-2), integrable constraint densities, charged matter DEC and weak trapping (fixed future/past sign on each component), E>|P|, invariant m>=Q, and full enclosing-area radius r_A<=m+sqrt(m^2-Q^2). The polynomial mass bound is only asserted for r_A>Q. In the connected outer-area-minimizing outermost future horizon class, m>Q equality identifies original data with a smooth spacelike dyonic RN slice through its future horizon, with the stated converse examples.
proof_architecture: Establish positivity of full-cut area with a bounded-comass closed two-form, identify filled perimeter minimizers, and prove compactness, directional derivatives over all minimizers, and compatible tangent planes.

Preserve closed flux forms, replace the weak end after removing finite-dimensional adjoint-kernel moments, repair the DEC conformally and bend to a strict rest end with energy tending to invariant mass and enclosing area converging. An energy-raising conformal family excludes a non-timelike ADM endpoint.

Define coupled height/compression scalars on long fillings. An exact curvature identity admits polynomial square coercivity. Floor exclusion, graph Sobolev/energy estimates and logarithmic iteration bound distortion; a trace-reversed Hessian flux and fixed-axis rough coefficient estimate bootstrap the coupled system. Moving-domain degree and fixed-N exhaustion solve it with normalized end.

Height separates the filling. A high conformal plateau excludes minimizer contact by a double-exponential lower area cost against an exponential competitor. A bounded scalar flux profile gives an exact ADM energy decrease, with a conformal area floor; a compact pure-trace tensor traps a regular height cut. The cited neutral theorem gives E_*>=sQ+(1-s^2)r_*/2, whose optimization yields both charged branches after ordered limits.

In equality, separate feasible variations for positive multipliers over all minimizing sheets. Gaussian finite-jet tests and compatible planes exclude larger marginal obstacles; obtain smooth normalized causal lapse/shift, global electromagnetic Killing potentials and original boundary surface gravity. Exclude causal frontiers, attach a smooth bifurcation band using all-order jets/parity, prove causality/communication, and apply the cited maximal-hypersurface theorem.

On the global maximal orbit section derive integral u'(|K'|^2+2|B'|^2+h_*|X'|^2)=0. This forces staticity and vanishing matter. Identify original invariant mass, apply connected electrostatic uniqueness with normalized lapse/potential, undo duality and recover the original slice smoothly through its future horizon. Verify static, compact non-time-symmetric and boosted sharp examples.

construction_ideas.idea: Remove finite-dimensional obstructions before supported inversion
construction_ideas.exact_assumptions: Euclidean scalar operator LH=partial_i partial_j(H_ij-tr(H)delta_ij), momentum Dk=partial_j(k_ij-tr(k)delta_ij), smooth annularly supported sources with zero affine moments or translation/rotation Killing moments; fixed positive bump yields positive-definite Gram matrices.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Project commutator sources onto bump-weighted adjoint-kernel tests, match moments exactly, then use supported divergence inverses on the remainder. Matching ADM vectors and integrable errors make projection coefficients small.
construction_ideas.possible_speculative_bridge: Compute symbolic cokernel/nullspace constraints over Q(Z) before optimizing determinant coefficients. Separate exact rank/nonzero-minor obstructions from analytic errors, tracking rational denominator and height costs explicitly.
construction_ideas.limits: Smooth Sobolev inverses do not provide an integral/rational analogue; projection can destroy arithmetic integrality or smallness.

construction_ideas.idea: Weighted block coercivity with parameter dependence tracked
construction_ideas.exact_assumptions: Rank-one slope axis; transverse eigenvalues one, axial d and chi=2d/(2+pv), 0<=p<=N. Exact square completion has positive residual d(8+v)/(3q^2).
construction_ideas.mechanism: Retain weighted axial contractions instead of bounding the unweighted Hessian. Coercivity costs only 20(1+N)^2, not reciprocal exponential slope weights. Later exp(P_N) estimates are kept distinct from polynomial losses.
construction_ideas.possible_speculative_bridge: Use block/Schur-complement normalization for weighted determinant columns while retaining small-direction weights and full symbolic rank; distinguish polynomial/exponential/fixed-parameter constants before an integer <1 contradiction.
construction_ideas.limits: Quadratic positivity is not determinant noncancellation; the needed arithmetic structure and residual coefficient require new proofs.

construction_ideas.idea: Use all optimizers and prove an exact compatibility lemma
construction_ideas.exact_assumptions: Smooth compact obstacle, confining one-ended geometry, perimeter submodularity, C^(1,1) regularity, strict BV compactness and continuous plane-measure integrals.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Area's right derivative is the minimum of first variations over all minimizers. Union/intersection still minimize; transverse tangent planes would create a forbidden corner, so averaged sheet tensors cannot cancel across planes.
construction_ideas.possible_speculative_bridge: Study the entire finite/compact set of optimal weighted minors or surviving terms and seek an algebraic sign/compatibility lemma before averaging certificates, rather than selecting one optimizer without control.
construction_ideas.limits: No supplied arithmetic submodularity or regularity analogue; determinants can have cancelling signs despite optimal supports.

construction_ideas.idea: An exact nonnegative identity upgrades a weak causal/complementarity constraint to full rigidity
construction_ideas.exact_assumptions: A connected bifurcation boundary; global exact magnetic Killing potential constant on that boundary; zero total rotated magnetic flux; a global maximal Cauchy orbit section with positive lapse; aligned residual stress h_* xi-flat tensor xi-flat, h_*>=0 and supported where W=0; decay killing all boundary terms.
construction_ideas.mechanism: The magnetic-potential integration converts the Poynting contribution into -integral u'|B'|^2. Combining the momentum constraint with sym grad X'=-u'K' gives one integral of three nonnegative terms equal to zero, forcing K'=B'=0 and removing residual stress.
construction_ideas.possible_speculative_bridge: For a determinant contradiction, look for an exact positive sum-of-squares or Gram identity whose vanishing is equivalent to the problematic symbolic rank defect. If available, an analytic smallness bound could force a discrete nonnegative quantity below its arithmetic gap while avoiding uncontrolled signed-term cancellation.
construction_ideas.limits: The identity uses topology, global exactness, connected boundary and decay; none has a supplied algebraic substitute. A Gram determinant can square height costs and may worsen the required smallness exponent.
